page.name: Quotes
page.description: Draft quotes with their lines, send them for signature and follow them until they are accepted.

table.caption: Quotes
table.search: Search a quote number or a customer

hints.vatRate: 6% for a private home over 10 years old, 21% for a business or a recent home. Left empty, the default rate of the settings applies.

addCustomer.title: New customer
addCustomer.description: Create the customer, then finish the quote.

empty.firstRunDescription: Draft a first quote for a customer: pick the products and quantities, then send it for signature.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another customer, status or period.

form.newDescription: It gets its number on save and stays a draft until you send it.
form.editDescription: Only drafts can be changed: what a customer received stays as sent.

quickView.title: Quote
quickView.description: The quote as it stands, with its lines and amounts.
quickView.notFoundDescription: It was deleted, or the link is wrong.

send.title: Send {number} to {customer}?
send.description: The customer receives the quote by email, with a link to read and sign it online.
send.impactPortal: The customer can accept it from the portal
send.impactLocked: The quote can no longer be edited
send.blockedDescription: Only a draft can be sent. Duplicate it to send a new version.

accept.title: Mark {number} as accepted?
accept.description: Records the customer's signature today. The installation can then be planned.

reject.title: Mark {number} as rejected?
reject.description: The quote is closed as lost. The reason, if you give one, is kept with the quote.

errors.notDraft: This quote is no longer a draft.
errors.notSent: This quote is not awaiting a signature.
errors.noPortalLink: A draft has no portal link yet: send it first.
errors.businessVat: A business customer pays 21% VAT: the 6% rate only covers a private home over 10 years old.
